crossRefs.note: Yes, he loved cursing, and it came to him. He didn’t delight in blessing, and it was far from him.
May all my enemies be ashamed and dismayed. They shall turn back, they shall be disgraced suddenly.
Let them be disappointed and confounded together who rejoice at my calamity. Let them be clothed with shame and…
I will clothe his enemies with shame, but on himself, his crown will shine.”
As for the head of those who surround me, let the mischief of their own lips cover them.
But Yahweh is with me as an awesome mighty one. Therefore my persecutors will stumble, and they won’t prevail. They…
Many of those who sleep in the dust of the earth will awake, some to everlasting life, and some to shame and…
Then my enemy will see it, and shame will cover her who said to me, where is Yahweh your God? Then my enemy will see me…

translations.web: Let my adversaries be clothed with dishonor. Let them cover themselves with their own shame as with a robe.
translations.bsb: May my accusers be clothed with disgrace; may they wear their shame like a robe.
translations.kjv: Let mine adversaries be clothed with shame, and let them cover themselves with their own confusion, as with a mantle.
translations.asv: Let mine adversaries be clothed with dishonor, And let them cover themselves with their own shame as with a robe.
